context: Evaluates whether the model correctly uses all seven @wailsapp/runtime logging functions (LogPrint, LogTrace, LogDebug, LogInfo, LogWarning, LogError, LogFatal) to implement severity-level dispatch. The key challenge is knowing which specific runtime function corresponds to each level string and forwarding the message argument correctly.

checklist.name: LogDebug usage
checklist.description: LogDebug is imported from @wailsapp/runtime and called with the message when level is 'debug'

checklist.name: LogError usage
checklist.description: LogError is imported from @wailsapp/runtime and called with the message when level is 'error'

checklist.name: LogFatal usage
checklist.description: LogFatal is imported from @wailsapp/runtime and called with the message when level is 'fatal'

checklist.description: LogWarning is imported from @wailsapp/runtime and called with the message when level is 'warning'

checklist.name: LogInfo usage
checklist.description: LogInfo is imported from @wailsapp/runtime and called with the message when level is 'info'

checklist.name: LogTrace usage
checklist.description: LogTrace is imported from @wailsapp/runtime and called with the message when level is 'trace'

checklist.name: LogPrint usage
checklist.description: LogPrint is imported from @wailsapp/runtime and called with the message when level is 'print'

checklist.name: Message forwarding
checklist.description: The original message string is passed unchanged as the argument to whichever runtime logging function is selected
